neutral.note: Tailwind zinc ramp (hex in the build, OKLCH equivalents listed here, converted exactly from the hex values). Canvas zinc-50 / zinc-950, surfaces white / zinc-900, borders zinc-200/70 / zinc-800/80.

contrast.note: WCAG ratios computed from the hex fallbacks (OKLCH values render identically). AA normal text needs 4.5:1; large text and non-text graphics need 3:1. Badge text uses the darker built-in 700 shades, not the 500/600 fills.

pairs.use: large text / icons only, never body copy
KNOWN GAP: 11-12px secondary metadata only (stat notes, timestamps). Body and badge text never use zinc-400. Fix tracked for a later round: raise secondary metadata to zinc-500.

motion.rule: Motion only for state changes. 200-400ms ease-out, transform/opacity only, gated by prefers-reduced-motion.

name: AI SDR Agent — design tokens (round 10)
note: One accent (indigo) on a flat zinc canvas. Colours are OKLCH with the hex they were converted from as fallback; the conversion is exact (same rendered colour as the round-9 hex ramp). Accent covers under 10% of any screen: the current pipeline step, the primary action, the focus ring. Semantic hues are status meaning only, never decoration. Type: Inter (text + display, tight tracking on headings) + JetBrains Mono (emails, ids, code). Numbers are tabular everywhere they change.

signature.idea: The numbered pipeline rail — one indigo numbered circle per agent step (research, people, writer, approval, sender, tracker), joined by a hairline, a check when done. The same rail appears on the Dashboard pipeline list and in Agent chat while a run is in progress. It is the one repeated visual: the product is a pipeline, and the rail shows where a campaign is in it.
signature.inspiration: Linear (flat zinc surfaces, one accent, tabular figures), Raycast (command palette, dense honest lists), Mobbin dashboard screens (numbered step rails, real data density)

type.figures: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every number that changes
type.mono: JetBrains Mono 400/500, emails / ids / code / kbd
